title: How to Build a Marketplace App With AI (Buyers, Sellers, Payments)
summary: Build a two-sided marketplace with listings, user roles, payments, and reviews using AI. Full-stack included — no Supabase, no Stripe setup, no DevOps.
body_markdown: The core marketplace — two user types, listings, search, checkout, reviews, and dashboards — builds in 2–4 hours with Blink. Category-specific customizations (service bookings, digital downloads, rental calendars) add another 1–2 hours. Most founders have a working MVP the same day they start. Traditional development takes 3–9 months and $40,000–300,000.
